name: Calle Cervantes · beds and hedge planters along the lane
about: Raised hedge planters and kerbed beds along Calle Miguel de Cervantes where the model left open paving between the lane and the houses (Dave, 16 November 2026: fill the areas around the path with patio walls, small border walls and planters). Each is a rectangle in the lane's own frame: s metres along the straight lane axis from the Dalí end, o metres off it (negative north, positive south); 'ring' is the same rectangle in model metres. The white kerb walls and soil are structure (Layout, solid, on the map); the planting is Show details only and keeps the route-clearance guard. Positions come from the ground photos, the registry house fronts and the lane tiles, good to about 1 m along the lane and 0.2 m across; heights by eye. The garden walls behind them are in data/lane_walls.json. Not a property survey and not placement approval.

planters.name: Cervantes west · planted bed between the lane kerb and the north garden wall
planters.basis: From the Dalí exit to the Elena steps the north side of the lane is a planted bed in front of a white garden wall: dracaena, jade and shrubs under bougainvillea near the Dalí end (IMG_2274, IMG_2468), a tall oleander hedge nearer Elena (IMG_2264, IMG_2467). The bed is at grade behind a low rounded kerb of about 0.15 m, which is the lane-edge wall cervantes-patio-north-1 (lowered from 0.65 m to match, independent review of 17 November 2026); it fills the 0.9 m to the new garden wall, whose line the three north patio partitions end on. The planting is Show details only.

planters.name: Cervantes east of Elena · lantana bed at the house front
planters.basis: IMG_2453, IMG_2796 and IMG_2797 look west along the lane past a house front with a barred window: a narrow bed of lantana (yellow and orange) and photinia runs along its foot, edged by a low kerb at the lane. Bed from the lane edge to the registry house front (6265401UF1366N_part3), which stands about 1.4 m off the lane centreline here; it stops where the house front steps out to the arched porch.

planters.name: Cervantes east of the porch · bed at the house front
planters.basis: Next to the arched porch (IMG_2450), on its Alberto side, the north house fronts, with grilles, lanterns and bougainvillea, have a narrow planted strip at their foot (IMG_2794). Bed from the lane edge to the registry house front (6265401UF1366N_part4).

planters.name: Cervantes before Alberto · bed at the house front
planters.basis: The same planted strip continues where the house front steps back to about 2 m off the centreline, up to the house corner before Calle Alberto (IMG_2794, IMG_2449 looking back west).

planters.name: Cervantes at Alberto · lantana and clipped hedge bed on the north corner
planters.basis: IMG_2448, from the Alberto crossing looking west: on the right a tall clipped hedge stands beside the two steps in an at-grade bed (bare soil and a gravel edge, no raised kerb), its east face at the crossing edge; the lantana of the house-front beds runs on up to it (IMG_2794, bottom right). The small raised white box on the crossing side of the house corner is not built.

planters.name: Cervantes east · raised hedge planter on the north side
planters.basis: IMG_2443 and IMG_2442 look west from near the Picasso end: beyond the white seat pillar, a shrub bed and a second brick-edged flight up into the north garden, the north side of the lane is a white raised planter with a dense clipped hedge. Its east end is read from IMG_2443 at about 2.2 times the seat front's distance from the camera, about 4-5 m west of the seat (independent review of 17 November 2026); its west end where the lawn of IMG_2446 begins. Ends good to about 1.5 m.

planters.name: Cervantes east · shrub bed between the north steps and the seat
planters.basis: IMG_2443: between the second brick-edged flight (about 114-115 m, not built) and the white seat, a low shrub bed at the lane edge. Extent estimated from the photo alone.

planters.name: Cervantes east · low brick-coped planter wall by the seat pillar
planters.basis: In the foreground of IMG_2442 and IMG_2443 a low white wall with a brick coping runs along the north edge of the lane from the white seat pillar and the brick-edged steps (not built: they stand in the gap left at 118.4-120.2 m) towards the Picasso end, with a clipped hedge behind it.

planters.name: Cervantes east end · white planter wall with a thuja hedge
planters.basis: IMG_2444 looks east along the last stretch to the car park: the house wall stands on the lane on the right (south), and on the left a white planter wall about 0.6 m high carries a tall clipped thuja hedge to the end of the lane, where the lawn and the car park open out.

planters.name: Cervantes east · raised hedge planter on the south side
planters.basis: IMG_2443 and IMG_2442: the south side of the lane west of the seat is a low white planter wall with a clipped hedge. Its east end is about 1 m west of the seat (IMG_2443, independent review of 17 November 2026); from there to the end house the photo shows lawn behind a low rounded kerb, which is not built. West end not visible in these photos.

planters.name: Cervantes to Alberto · narrow bed at the foot of the south wall
planters.basis: IMG_2449, IMG_2450 and IMG_2794: a narrow bed of jade and young bougainvillea runs along the foot of the tall south wall behind an aggregate strip; it stops at the two doors. Width from the lane edge to the wall face.

planters.name: Cervantes at the Elena north mouth · raised hedge and fan-palm bed along the corner patio wall
planters.basis: The white raised bed along the Cervantes edge in front of the corner patio wall (lane_walls.json elena-north-corner-patio-wall): clipped hedge with plumbago from the Elena 24 garden-door planter (IMG_2463), then fan palms to the corner, where it meets the bed up the Elena north mouth (data/elena_north_corner.json). It replaces the 0.65 m wall cervantes-patio-north-east, which stood at its lane face; the face is set at 0.95 m, the lane paving limit, and the back is the patio wall. Kerb 0.5 m: in IMG_2800 the bed corner is 145 px tall where the 0.4 m tiles beside it are about 125 px. Estimated to about 0.5 m along, 0.2 m across.
